implementation_identity: Exact clean Git implementation HEAD recorded before each trial; source and service image bytes also verified
environment: Existing task-owned patch-audit-g3c Docker/PostgreSQL/evaluator stack on loopback; no real provider credentials
per_trial: Record attempt before starting, including implementation SHA and service/container/image identities
Run the original unchanged-strength cancellation/completed-evidence-loss/missing-terminal restart test once
Retain exit status, all test output and timestamped API/evaluator logs, including failures
Record recovered and missing audit IDs, readiness elapsed time, validated completed evidence identity and interrupted missing-result classification
Verify only one broker execution submission for the recovered completed ID; no new submission during recovery
Verify recorded sandbox resources are absent and service is usable
stop_rule: Stop immediately on an unexplained hang, failed trial or identity/cleanup violation; never replace a failure or exceed five trials
full_suite_separate: The required complete e2e suite includes the original restart regression once in addition to these five bounded stress trials; recovery smoke and unrelated inherited restart tests remain explicit engineering checks, not additional stress trials or G3 candidate trials
